== Version ==
These guides cover '''1.0.0.0''', released as '''1.0''' on 25 November 2026. See [[Version 1.0.0.0]] for the release that ends Early Access and [[Versions]] for earlier versions. Other versions may differ.

[[Version 0.9.9.7|The 0.9.9.7 tester]] remains a historical reference. Default stats and acquisition tables describe public 1.0.0.0; [[Achievements]] explains the release's unlock conditions and limits.
